issue_context.title: Metadata/Enriched envelope: Adapt the new envelope's avro schema to json
issue_context.body:
Use the work in this issue (https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/139655) to generate the schema in the JSON output

Jira issue: CRDB-46760

review_comments: Thoughts on naming this package `kafkaconnect` and then the exported struct could either stay as `Schema` or be renamed to `JSONSchema`?
hmm that would be more aesthetically appealing, let me think about it. my only hesitation is i dont have any notion that we're going to add anything else to do with kafka connect besides this
Are the words envelope and schema synonyms in this context? Should this variable and the NewEnrichedEnvelope reference schemas instead of envelopes?

it's in a package named schema and returns something of type schema. see the guidance in https://go.dev/doc/effective_go#package-names

likewise appending `Schema` to before, after, and source i dont think adds much clarity, esp since we're in makeValueSchema etc
moved from avro so we can reuse it in json
What is kafka connect? It seems like this is the only kind of JSON schema we emit and we would emit it even for non-kafka sinks if schema is specified. Is that a sensible use case?

What we're trying to match is specifically the Kafka Connect JSON Schema format. Regardless of sink we're sending to

see https://github.com/a0x8o/kafka/blob/master/connect/json/src/main/java/org/apache/kafka/connect/json/JsonConverter.java
